author: m.kalinin
content:
The following type doesn't enforce any additional constraints and `ProgressiveList[AttesterSlashing]` looks unambiguous:
```python
class AttesterSlashings(ProgressiveList[AttesterSlashing]):
    """
    The attester slashings included in a beacon block.
    """
```
What is the purpose of introducing a new type? cc <@881905303011086387>

author: etan_status
content: being able to redefine just the type across forks, rather than having to redefine logic

author: etan_status
content: it was List[AttesterSlashing, limit] in older fork

author: m.kalinin
content: isn't it achievable with switching from `List[AttesterSlashing, N]` to `ProgressiveList[AttesterSlashing]`?
